name: nexus-erp
description: Nexus ERP - combined application (Finance-Loan, General Ledger, Exchange Vehicles)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma generate
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx ts-node prisma/seed-admin.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-finance-manager.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-real-branches.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-demo-employees.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-lenders.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-gl-provisional-accounts.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-rc-book-rules.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-valuation-rules.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed-loans.ts
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run db" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5433 && npm run db:migrate && npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
